messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thank you, John. I found your account. I see you have line 555-123-2002 (line ID L1002), which is Active and has roaming enabled (though you're not roaming).

Since you can make calls and use mobile data, the basic connectivity seems okay. MMS issues are often caused by APN settings (specifically the MMSC URL), network mode, Wi-Fi Calling, or app permissions.

Let's start by checking your APN settings. On your phone, please run: **check_apn_settings**

This will show your current APN name and MMSC URL. Share what it displays.

The APN settings on your phone show the APN name as "internet" and the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." These are technical settings usually best left unchanged. Do you want me to check or adjust anything specific here, or should we try another step?

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
